about.title: About Us
about.heading: Heritage of
about.description: Natarsal was born from a love for Indonesia's rich culinary heritage. We bring authentic flavors from Sabang to Merauke with an elegant modern touch.

items.name: Mark Wiens
items.content: Natarsal delivers an extraordinary culinary experience! The beef rendang is the best I've ever tasted.

items.name: Gordon Ramsay
items.content: As a chef, I truly appreciate the quality of ingredients and cooking techniques used at Natarsal.
